summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 35 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: White House Considers Vetting A.I. Models Before They Are Released
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 33 articles published in the last 24 hours
